name: IPMA Portugal open data API (hourly station observations)
short: Hourly Portuguese station observations as one JSON file. No key; non-commercial use, cite source.
summary: The Instituto Portugues do Mar e da Atmosfera runs api.ipma.pt. observation/meteorology/stations/observations.json returns about 24 hours of hourly values keyed by timestamp then station id (temperature, humidity, pressure, wind speed and direction, accumulated precipitation, radiation; -99 means missing). On 2026-11-07 it spanned 2026-11-06T18:00 to 2026-11-07T17:00 UTC. stations.json gives the id to name and coordinates (GeoJSON), e.g. Olhao. Sibling endpoints on the docs page include city forecasts, warnings and seismic observations (listed, not all called).

tasks: hourly observations at Portuguese stations (temperature, humidity, pressure, wind, precipitation)

coverage.notes: Mainland Portugal and islands; station ids join to stations.json.

delivery.basis: Live GET 2026-11-07: latest timestamp 2026-11-07T17:00 in a file fetched around 18:20 UTC.

latency.typical: About one hour after observation hour

licensing.summary: IPMA's Condicoes de Utilizacao (api.ipma.pt, in Portuguese) allow use of the site's information for personal or public use provided it does not serve profit-making or offensive aims, and the source must always be cited. Commercial reuse therefore needs IPMA's agreement. The API page asks users to read the terms and email webmaster@ipma.pt about their use and purpose. AI training is not addressed.

time.unknown: Report time is the provider's own stamp.

location.unknown: Fixed station or event coordinates; not independently checked.

content.unknown: Agency values; no independent check documented.
content.method: Official station readings; -99 marks missing values.

human.unknown: Not applicable: automated instruments or official analysis, not people.

application.unknown: No signing or attestation from instrument to API is documented.

camera.unknown: Not applicable: no camera frames in this feed.

corroboration.unknown: Nothing documented independently confirms individual readings.

auth.how_to_get: No key. Provider requests an email to webmaster@ipma.pt describing use.

endpoints.notes: Hourly values by timestamp and station id.
GeoJSON station list with id and name.
Seismic observations (from the docs page; not called).

api.rate_limits: No numeric limit stated; the provider asks users to email webmaster@ipma.pt describing purpose.
api.notes: JSON and GeoJSON. Non-commercial reuse stated.

sources.claim: Live keyless GET 2026-11-07: HTTP 200 JSON keyed by hour 2026-11-06T18:00 to 2026-11-07T17:00
Station list GeoJSON with id and location name
Conditions of use: no profit-making use, source must be cited; request to email about use
